name: FAB
purpose: A single, prominent floating action reachable from anywhere in the current view — optionally expanding into 1-3 closely related actions via a speed-dial.
neverUseFor: The only way to reach an action also available inline — FAB is a shortcut, not the sole path; if removing it would make an action unreachable, it belongs in the page's normal flow instead
A toggle/pressed state — same exclusion as IconButton; compose a dedicated toggle control instead
More than 3 revealed actions — a speed-dial with many actions is a Menu wearing a costume; use Menu once it exists
Anything other than the single most important action in the current view — a second FAB on the same screen competes with itself
rationale: FAB is a single prominent floating shortcut: it reuses semantic.size.xl (48px) as its one 'm' rung per ADR-004 and is one of the few surfaces allowed a shadow because it genuinely floats (ADR-005). It must never be the only path to an action, and the speed-dial is capped at 1-3 related actions.

mayExtendLocally: Choose the icon, accessible label and 1-3 speed-dial actions
Decide which views show a FAB
mustEscalateToDS: Adding sizes, extended (text) FABs or more than three actions
Making FAB the only way to reach an action
Adding toggle/pressed state or changing its position model

authored.name: expanded
authored.description: The speed-dial actions are revealed. Rendered inline (no portal) — same hand-rolled-disclosure category as Select/Checkbox, not a Dialog/Popover/Menu primitive decision.

anatomy.description: Root — always a real <button>, circular (width = height, radius.full), fixed-position by the consumer's layout, never by the component itself.
The trigger's icon, rendered via the Icon component.
The speed-dial group — inline sibling buttons revealed when expanded=true, mirrored into the Liquid morph group.
One revealed action — icon + accessible label, visually smaller than the trigger.

props.name: icon
props.description: The trigger's icon, passed by reference (e.g. IconPlus), not pre-instantiated.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the trigger — there is no visible text, so this is required, rendered as aria-label.

props.name: actions
props.type: Array<{ icon: TablerIcon; label: string; onClick: () => void }>
props.description: The speed-dial actions revealed when expanded. Omit for a plain single-action FAB with no speed-dial at all.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled expanded state. Omit `actions` to skip the speed-dial entirely rather than passing expanded with nothing to reveal.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fired when the speed-dial opens or closes (trigger press, action press, or outside click).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Trigger press handler — fires whether or not `actions` is set. When `actions` is set, pressing the trigger also toggles `expanded`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional className for the root. Positioning (fixed/absolute + inset) is the consumer's responsibility — FAB does not position itself.

height.note: Single size only, v1 — reuses the existing semantic.size.xl token (48px), already defined but unwired to any component before this. Per ADR-004, a component with only one rung must still label it 'm'. Revealed actions (fab-action) render at 36px (primitive.size.225), a documented local exception, same category as Badge/Chip's local density model.

width.note: Always equal to height (circular) — aliases the same token as height, not an independent value, same pattern as IconButton.

keyboardNav: Enter/Space — activates the trigger (toggles the speed-dial if actions exist)
Escape — collapses the speed-dial when expanded
Tab — moves focus through revealed actions in order when expanded
wcag: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (label is required — no visible text to fall back on)

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: true = the speed dial open: actions stacked above the trigger, 8px apart (code's baseOffset/step), the trigger icon turned 45°. Only state=default exists for it — a disabled FAB can't open.

properties.name: state
properties.description: hover/press/focus are CSS; disabled = the `disabled` prop — fill/disabled + icon/disabled, no shadow (no opacity).

figma.structure: fab-root 48px (size/xl, radius/full, fill/primary, shadow / m, 20px icon) and fab-action 36px (fill/page, 1px border/neutral in the layout, shadow / s, 16px icon). Icons are swapped per instance (icon / actions[].icon).
